verdict.rationale: Lambda instances ship with a preinstalled JupyterLab server and SSH access out of the box, letting a developer open Jupyter or SSH in with no extra setup (docs-3, docs-7). However, there's no explicit documentation of a one-step VS Code/Cursor Remote-SSH or dev-container integration — only generic SSH connectivity is mentioned, requiring the developer to manually configure their IDE's remote connection. Missing for 10: explicit VS Code/Cursor connection docs or one-click IDE integration, independent confirmation that IDE remote-attach works smoothly.
